observations: Photo 0: Close-up of a used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly, torque converter bell housing visible with bolt pattern, heavy oxidation/surface rust on metal casing, oily residue, sitting on a dirt/concrete floor in what looks like a parts yard.
Photo 1: Close-up of a transmission case section near a wiring harness connector, loose cut/exposed wires (red, blue, orange) twisted together, dust and grime on casing.
Photo 2: Another used transmission/gearbox unit, different casing shape, dangling sensor wires and hoses, surrounded by other used parts and engines in a cluttered yard.
No printed part numbers, VIN tags, or model plates are legible in any photo.
A 'NZ JAPANESE AUTOS' watermark appears on all images, indicating the seller's own branding/source stamp, not an independent verification.

identity.kind: used automatic/manual gearbox (transmission assembly) for Toyota Corolla/Carry/Hilux as claimed

claims.claim: Automatic gearbox and manual gearbox available for Toyota Corolla, Carry, Hilux
claims.evidence: No vehicle-specific tags, stickers, or part numbers visible in any photo to confirm which gearbox matches which model.

claims.claim: Implied working/functional condition (standard for such listings)
claims.evidence: No video of the gearbox shifting, no bench test, no fluid check shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Exact vehicle/engine fitment (which gearbox goes with which model/year) cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Photo of stamped part number or OEM tag on the casing, matched to a parts catalog
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used gearbox of unconfirmed fitment, not model-specific

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (clutch packs, gears, torque converter) unknown; rust and grime visible suggest age/yard storage
risks.proof: Video of gearbox being tested on a stand or in a running vehicle, showing smooth shifting
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts or rebuild

risks.risk: Cut and loosely twisted wiring harness in photo 1 may indicate missing connectors, prior electrical fault, or incomplete sensor harness (critical for automatic units)
risks.proof: Close-up of harness connectors fully intact and photo of mating connector on vehicle side
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a damaged/incomplete wiring harness

risks.risk: Mileage, accident history, or reason for removal unknown (could be from a wrecked or high-mileage donor vehicle)
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle or its mileage/odometer, or any paperwork
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case as unknown-history used part

proof_requests: Clear photo of any stamped part/model number on the gearbox casing
Video of the gearbox being bench-tested or installed and running, showing gear engagement
Close-up of the wiring harness connectors to confirm none are cut or missing
Photo showing which specific gearbox corresponds to which vehicle model (Corolla vs Carry vs Hilux)
response.reason: The items are identifiable by type as used Toyota transmission/gearbox assemblies, but exact model fitment, functional condition, and harness integrity are all unverified from the photos, so they must be priced at worst case as untested, generic used gearboxes pending further proof.
